svg.title: GrayPointer block diagram
svg.desc: In the own clock domain, bin_ptr + inc feeds the bin_ptr flop and, through a binary-to-Gray conversion, the gray_q flop. Only gray_q crosses the boundary, into a CDCSynchronizer on far_clk. A Gray-to-binary conversion turns the synchronized value into far_bin_ptr.
svg.text: GrayPointer: one pointer, read in two clock domains
Only gray_q crosses the dashed line, and one of its bits changes per clk edge. Thick border: flop.
